visual_text: Carers reported about 69 and a half hours of care a week
Median among carers of people who died of cancer in England, 2015
One week: 168 hours (for scale only; 69 h 30 min is a median across carers, not one person's week)
Over 9 in 10 carers reported giving care
Self-reported by 1,504 bereaved relatives who had registered a cancer death (28.5% replied). The published abstract does not say whether the hours include time on call. Cancer deaths only.
Alasdair MacLullich | Who gets left out
alt_text: Bar drawn to scale: a week of 168 hours split into seven days, with the first 69 and a half hours shaded. Carers of people who died of cancer in England in 2015 reported a median of 69 h 30 min of care a week; over 9 in 10 gave care. For scale only. Self-reported by 1,504 bereaved relatives (28.5% replied).
